changes: Strict checkpoint stores persist authoritative lease owner, lease token, fencing token, and lease expiry after the first valid strict write.
Later strict writes derive observed lease and fencing evidence from persisted lease authority rather than caller-selected cas_context values.
Lease expiry checks use an integration-owned evaluation time; caller-selected observed_at and expiry extension cannot bypass the guard.
A non-empty strict store without valid lease authority fails closed and routes to reconciliation.
Committed effects bind lease expiry in addition to owner, token, and fencing lineage.
Adversarial regressions cover new-idempotency stale-agent writes, caller expiry extension, missing lease authority, exact replay after expiry, and legacy callers.
